item.text: The campaign is live with UK and Ireland targeting, testing the product-and-offer post against the “rerun job” post among people discussing CI tools and flaky tests. Initial limits are $50 per day and $400 total, leaving $100 to allocate after reviewing performance. All ads are scheduled to end at midnight after Sunday 29 November, UK time.
Both ads are delivering. The first check shows $20.09 spent and six link clicks—too little evidence to choose a winner. I’ll keep the initial test running and review it again tomorrow.
Spend is now $57.90 for 16 link clicks. The rerun post has a lower cost per click ($3.13 versus $4.00), but the sample is still small. I’ll give both posts a working-day test before shifting budget.

The campaign has spent $108.81 for 35 link clicks. The rerun post is still cheaper per click ($2.84 versus $3.34), so I’ve shifted the daily split to $30 for that post and $20 for the product post. I’ve also added “Jenkins pipeline” targeting and kept $100 reserved for the closing days. These are traffic results; sign-up performance remains unknown.
Today’s check shows $156.64 spent, 106,366 impressions and 52 link clicks. The rerun post retains a modest cost-per-click advantage, so I’m keeping the current split while more results accumulate.

Spend is $194.00 for 62 link clicks. The rerun post remains slightly cheaper, though neither post has a decisive lead. I’ll put the reserved $100 behind the approved deadline post from Thursday through Sunday to test the offer’s closing urgency.

item.text: The afternoon check shows $466.82 spent and 135 link clicks. All three ad groups retain their midnight end time, and their combined lifetime limits remain $500. I’ll let the remaining allowance run through the final hours.

The campaign has ended at midnight after Sunday 29 November, UK time. I’ve also paused it and confirmed it can no longer serve. I’ll pull the closing report after one more hour for reporting to catch up.

Campaign completed for 21–29 November, UK time, and is now paused. I monitored all nine days and adjusted budgets across three approved posts.

- Spend: **$486.93 USD** of $500
- Impressions: **312,777**
- Link clicks: **141**
- Average cost per link click: **$3.45**

Targeting stayed within the UK and Ireland. Sign-ups remain unmeasured by X; these reported totals are ready to compare with your own sign-up counts.
